fact: The Interior Ministry's public-security policy page states, as its outlook for 2025, that the Police nationale will acquire computer applications to modernise and secure the sensitive data it processes and that work on the Plan de développement stratégique de la Police nationale will be finalised, the plan therefore not yet being in force; it names no station records system.
title: Politique de Sécurité publique
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité publique
